normalization: lowercase ASCII letters a-z only; delete all other characters for palindrome tape. Reject unsupported rendering characters separately; no Unicode lookalikes, numbers or unsupported symbols.
exactness: nonempty normalize(text)==normalize(text)[::-1]; punctuation/capitalization ignored only for exactness, remain important for reading
candidate_rules: Aim for one intelligible scene or contrast, consistent actors and action progression.
Use grammatical phrases/clauses as construction units; do not just concatenate independently palindromic sentences.
ABCBA is an allowed arm, not the only pattern or a mandatory template.
Repetition is allowed and measured continuously; do not discard a good reading solely for repetition.
Target60-180letters when language supports it; shorter meaningful cases remain useful and must not be padded.
Record failed exact attempts; never hide or silently repair rejected proposals.
Avoid name-swapped deliver/revile filler; use existing fragments only if they serve a scene.
Known/copy sources disclosed separately; no novelty claim.
scale: grammar/readability/coherence0-4; repetition_burden0-4(higher worse); meaningful_progression boolean; padding_or_loop boolean
blinding: Evaluator receives only shuffled blind_id/text, not source method, prior human labels, exactness outcome, model scores or rank. Score readability before any length objective.
batch_checkpoint: Save each generation/evaluation batch raw outputs and receipt to Library before starting another; no scores inferred from missing batches.
ranking: Keep raw dimensions and Pareto frontier. Optional utility: readability +0.5*coherence +0.5*grammar +0.5*min(letters,180)/180 -0.5*repetition_burden; mark padding/loop, do not count length bonus on flagged text. No repetition veto.
comparison: Fixed12baseline versus up to24proposals from three declared methods; exactness failures retained but excluded from valid palindrome performance. This is a small pilot, not broad population evidence.

seam_schema.grammar_relation: nonempty description; annotation is not independent grammar verification

ABCBA_rule: Exactly5block tapes: first==reverse(last), second==reverse(fourth), center is exact palindrome. Blocks can span partial words; all block tapes together must exactly reconstruct global text.
